title: PCBuildSage Local Backend Preset
description: A named preset for a local OpenAI-compatible serving backend (llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang, LM Studio, TGI, ...). Data over code: every such backend speaks /v1, so presets prefill base_url/port and tool-enablement notes instead of adding per-backend code paths.

name.description: Human-facing preset name shown in the provider picker.

provider_class.description: All local backends are reached through the single openai-compatible provider class.

base_url.description: Default OpenAI-style base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1.

requires_key.description: false for keyless local servers; a dummy key is sent only if the server rejects an empty header.

model_list_style.description: Which listing endpoint to hit for model discovery: OpenAI /v1/models or Ollama /api/tags.

tool_support_notes.description: How to enable tool calling on this backend (surfaced when the tool-capability probe fails).

launch_flags.description: Optional exact launch-flag hint to enable tool calling.
